newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Schroder ups Protein Design.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Schroder ups Protein Design.

text.p: -- Schroder Wertheim said it raised its rating of Protein Design Labs Inc to outperform from perform in line.
-- Schroder Wertheim raised its rating after Protein Design secured a U.S. patent covering most humanized monoclonal antibodies.
-- Protein Design "could stand to realize considerable royalty revenue over time," Schroder said.
-- Schroder cut its 1997 loss estimate to $1.34 a share from $1.41 a share, and the 1998 loss estimate to $1.28 a share from $1.64 a share.
-- Schroder set 12-month target share price of $36 a share.
-- Protein Design gained 1-5/8 to 33-1/8 in afternoon trading.
